kultivator.sekte_langit.visual.title: Sky Views
kultivator.sekte_langit.visual.foot: Effect quality: %s  ·  the sky drew %s quads last frame  ·  sky halls synced: %s
Three cloud layers below the island, fixed to the world and drifting with today's wind. They fade out to 384 blocks.
kultivator.sekte_langit.visual.airTerjun: Ribbons of water pouring from the notches of the island's rim and turning to mist. Drawing only: no real water ever falls off the island.
kultivator.sekte_langit.visual.sungaiBin: The Milky Way and twinkling stars above the clouds on clear nights, turning with the sky.
kultivator.sekte_langit.visual.halo.tip: On some dawns, with the sun low behind you, a rainbow ring appears on the cloud sea around your own shadow (inspired by the Golden Summit of Mount Emei).
kultivator.sekte_langit.visual.bangau.ti: Red-crowned cranes fly round the island in a V by day.
kultivator.sekte_langit.visual.kelopak.t: Petals from the island's plum trees blow past the rim and fade below the clouds.
kultivator.sekte_langit.visual.lentera.t: On festival nights (three nights after the Ascension, the world's new year, after a tournament) paper lanterns rise from the plaza.
kultivator.sekte_langit.visual.cuacaKeba: Above the cloud sea the sky is always clear: rain and snow are not drawn or heard there. The storm still falls on the ground below.
kultivator.sekte_langit.visual.suaraAmbi: Wind at the rim, the gate bell at dawn, wind chimes under the eaves, crane wings and the patter of the mist falls.
